# Release 1.21 — Storage tiers & free-tier quota guards

**Status:** Outline — freeze when 1.20 ships  
**Milestone:** `1.21`  
**Parent strategy:** [Nivesh_Product_Requirements_and_Roadmap_v1.2.md](../Nivesh_Product_Requirements_and_Roadmap_v1.2.md)  
**Architecture source of truth:** [../superpowers/specs/2026-11-11-wealth-orbit-architecture-evaluation-design.md](../superpowers/specs/2026-11-11-wealth-orbit-architecture-evaluation-design.md)  
**Rule:** Do not edit this file to mark done or change scope after `Approved for freeze`. Status → GitHub only.

---

## Outcome

Operators and the app can keep a **full seed universe useful for screeners and stance (Tier A)** on free/minimal-cost Supabase, while **deep 10y OHLC/NAV (Tier B)** expands by priority without silently filling the disk to read-only. Connection usage uses a **small app-side pool** through the existing **session pooler**. Unbounded `max` history is refused or hard-warned on free-tier posture.

End-state ambition remains “full universe toward 10y history,” but **day-one and free-tier safe path** is Tier S + Tier A complete first, then Tier B by priority.

---

## Locked decisions

| Decision | Choice | Agent implication |
|----------|--------|-------------------|
| Cost posture | Prefer free (A); max rare light paid bump (B) | Do not require paid market-data APIs; paid bump only for disk/LLM later |
| Universe ambition | Full seed lists (~500 stocks / ~280 funds / ~12 indexes) | Masters always loaded (Tier S) |
| Hot metrics | Tier A always hot for full universe | Screener + Stance L1 must not require 10y bars for every symbol |
| Deep history | Tier B priority: holdings → watchlist → recently viewed → opportunistic bulk | Do not default “sync all 10y overnight” without quota check |
| Dual store | Unchanged: SQLite private / Postgres shared | Never write portfolio ledger into Supabase in this release |
| Pooler | Session mode port 5432 (`*.pooler.supabase.com`) per 1.3 | Reject transaction 6543 / direct db host patterns already enforced |
| Compression/Timescale | Not in 1.21 | Only revisit if Tier B still cannot fit after trim + B bump policy |
| `max` history | Not allowed as default on free posture | CLI/UI must warn or refuse |

---

## Tier definitions (normative)

### Tier S — Masters (always hot)

- `stock_reference`, `mutual_fund_reference`, `index_reference`, taxonomy tables  
- Seed CSVs / track-beyond-seed masters (1.5–1.6)  
- Cheap row counts; must be complete for discovery UX  

### Tier A — Screener / stance fuel (always hot for full active universe)

- Latest `stock_daily_metrics` (latest-only policy already exists)  
- Capped fundamentals (`stock_fundamental_values` retention: 5 annual + 6 quarterly per basis)  
- Latest `stock_technical_indicators` (latest-day only)  
- `mutual_fund_metric_snapshots`, enrichment facts needed for fund screens  
- Shareholding latest snapshots as needed for screens  

**Purpose:** Stock/fund screeners and Stance Engine L1 (1.23) run on stored snapshots **without** scanning full OHLC history for every symbol.

### Tier B — Deep history (expand toward 10y)

- `stock_daily_prices`, `mutual_fund_nav_history`, `index_daily_history`  
- Default horizon remains **10y** when quota allows (`DEFAULT_HISTORY_PERIOD`)  
- Priority order for backfill and retention protection:  
  1. Instruments in any user portfolio holdings  
  2. Instruments on any user watchlist (1.22)  
  3. Recently viewed / recently synced instruments  
  4. Remaining seed universe opportunistic backfill  

If watchlists (1.22) are not shipped yet, implement priority using holdings + explicit “tracked” flags from 1.6 + recently synced, and leave a hook for watchlist IDs.

## Foundation

- [ ] Single Postgres access helper with **pooling** (small pool size appropriate for personal + session pooler); migrate hot paths off per-call connect
- [ ] Quota/size probe before bulk Tier B seed/sync (query DB size or documented Supabase-safe equivalent); clear operator message when near/over free disk
- [ ] Bulk seed/sync path refuses or requires explicit override for `period=max` under free posture
- [ ] Retention + `trim_market_history` remain the recovery tool; document when to run after quota events
- [ ] Tier A completeness check: report how many active stocks/funds lack latest metrics / fundamentals / MF snapshots
- [ ] Sync/seed logs never print DB passwords or service role keys

---

## Backlog

### Policy enforcement

- [ ] Codify Tier S/A/B in `docs/setup.md` and seed CLI help text (point to this release)
- [ ] Guided setup / seed orchestrator prefers: indexes + masters → Tier A metrics/fundamentals/technicals/MF snapshots → Tier B history by priority
- [ ] UI or operator sync enqueue for “full universe 10y prices” shows disk risk and runs quota probe
- [ ] Document light paid bump (B): only after Tier A complete and Tier B blocked by quota — engineering does not auto-upgrade billing

### Retrieval performance

- [ ] Screeners and list endpoints continue to use indexed latest snapshots (no full-history scans)
- [ ] Chart/history endpoints remain per-symbol date-bounded
- [ ] Confirm indexes on `(stock_id, trading_date)`, NAV PK, metrics lookups still used by explain plans for common queries (document in PR if checked)

### Connection health

- [ ] Replace remaining ad-hoc `psycopg2.connect` in reference/sync paths with pooled helper where practical
- [ ] Retry behavior for “too many connections” / read-only remains; add metric or log counter for connection failures

### Tests

- [ ] Unit: retention cutoff and `max` refusal/warning behavior  
- [ ] Unit or integration: Tier B priority ordering function  
- [ ] Smoke: pooled connection can `SELECT 1` through session pooler URL shape  

---

## Out of scope

- Deleting dual-store architecture  
- Partitioning / Timescale / columnar compression  
- Stance scoring (1.23)  
- Watchlist product UI (1.22) — only priority hooks  
- Paying for commercial market-data feeds  
- Microservice databases  

---

## Exit

Operators can complete Tier A for the seed universe on free/minimal Supabase; Tier B backfill is priority-ordered and quota-aware; `max` is not a silent default; app uses pooled DB access via session pooler; screeners still work from snapshots when deep history is incomplete.

---

## Agent planning instructions

1. Treat full-universe **10y OHLC for all symbols on day one** as an anti-goal for free tier.  
2. Any seed plan must state which tier it fills (S/A/B).  
3. Do not remove existing retention/fundamentals caps.  
4. Do not switch to transaction pooler (6543) or direct `db.*.supabase.co` — violates 1.3.  
5. If implementing watchlist priority before 1.22 UI, keep a stable interface (`instrument_ref`, `priority_reason`) so 1.22 plugs in.  
6. Prefer fixing connection churn over adding Redis.  
7. One GitHub issue per checkbox; milestone `1.21`.  
8. Ship and validate before merging 1.22 feature work into the same unchecked scope.

## Free-tier risk register (carry forward)

| Risk | Severity | Mitigation in this release |
|------|----------|----------------------------|
| Disk from full 10y OHLC+NAV | High | Tier B priority + probe + trim + B bump policy |
| Screener needs all symbols | Medium | Tier A always-hot |
| Connection limits | Medium | App pool + session pooler |
| Paused project read-only | Medium | Keep existing detection |
| DB egress | Low | Provider→app dominates |
